description: This file defines a CKEditor plugin dialog called 'pastetext' used for pasting text into the editor. It sets up the dialog's layout, contents, and the behavior when the dialog is shown or submitted.

methods.name: onShow
methods.description: Sets up the content of the dialog when it is displayed.

methods.name: onOk
methods.description: Handles the event when the OK button is pressed, commits the dialog content.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the textarea with empty content when the dialog is displayed.

methods.name: commit
methods.description: Fires a paste event with the entered text when the user confirms input.
